title: Analytics — agregat instruktur per kelas
description: Instructor+ analytics for belajar-with-rahmanef.com: per-materi completion counts, course-completion (badge) count, tenant member count, quiz attempt/pass stats per course, and — 0.3.0 — READER counts: the per-course drop-off funnel and the community's weekly pulse. Aggregates are derived on read over shared tables with documented bounded takes (no bare .collect(), P1) and carry no user identifiers. ONE write: MateriViewRecorder → insight/views:recordView, member-only and idempotent per member per materi per WIB day. EVERY reader number counts LOGGED-IN MEMBERS ONLY — anonymous reads are invisible — and MembersOnlyNote ships that caveat with the numbers. No routes: the Kelola › Statistik tab mounts TenantPulseView + CourseAnalyticsView (which leads with CourseFunnelView). 0.2.0: module grouping dropped (DECISIONS #37).

kelola › statistik tab (alpha #17): TenantPulseView(tenantId) ← denyut komunitas di atas daftar kelas
CourseAnalyticsView ← courseId dari daftar kelas di tab Statistik
useCourseSummaries(tenantId) ← angka {completionCount, memberCount} di daftar kelas kelola
reading surfaces (materi permalink, skil: MateriViewRecorder(tenantId, lessonId) ← renders null; fires recordView once per mount for members only
